api/BOOSEapp.html.summary: Namespace BOOSEapp Classes AppCanvas Provides an implementation of the BOOSE.ICanvas interface using GDI+ System.Drawing functionality for drawing operations. AppCircle Represents a command to draw an unfilled circle on the canvas. AppClear Represents a command to clear the drawing canvas. AppCommandFactory Implements a concrete command factory for the BOOSE application. AppDrawTo Represents a command to draw a line from the current pen position to a new specified coordinate. AppMoveTo Represents a command to move the drawing pen to a new coordinate without drawing a line. AppPenColour Represents a command to set the color of the drawing pen on the canvas using RGB values. AppRect Represents a command to draw an unfilled rectangle on the canvas. Form1 Represents the main graphical user interface for the BOOSE Interpreter application. This form manages user input, displays the drawing output, and controls the program execution flow.
